name: ZCA_ES_SAVED_SEARCHES_B
description: This table is used to store the saved searches for a user

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_UUID
columns.description: the primary key

columns.name: SHARED_FLAG
columns.description: This flag will allow user to share a private Saved Search. Allowed values are Y or N

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_NUMBER
columns.description: PUID used for migration between envs

columns.name: ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: the entity that this saved search is for

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: the user that this saved search is for

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Obsolete

columns.name: KEYWORDS
columns.description: keywords used to filter the entity for this saved search

columns.name: KEYWORDS_FIELDS_LIST_JSON
columns.description: the serialized JSON the  array of fields to search on in addition to the "all" field

columns.name: QUERY_JSON
columns.description: the serailized JSON that represents the query expression for this saved search

columns.name: AGGREGATIONS_JSON
columns.description: The serialized JSON that represents the aggregations for this saved search

columns.name: SORT_JSON
columns.description: the serialized JSON for the array of sort criteria

columns.name: ENTITIES_JSON
columns.description: the serialized JSON that represents array of entities and fields for this saved search

columns.name: HIGHLIGHTS_JSON
columns.description: the serialized JSON for the array of fields to be highlighted for this saved search

columns.name: FIELDS_JSON
columns.description: the serialized JSON for the array of fields to be returned in the result set

columns.name: EXCLUDE_JSON
columns.description: the serialized JSON for the array of fields to be excluded in the result payload

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the row was deleted, otherwise N

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The Access Level for this Saved Search. Values can be Private, Public and Role

columns.name: DEFAULT_LAYOUT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The default Layout Type

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
